role: Stage 2 (second-stage, post-hoc) analysis plan for the discovery snRNA re-annotation
sha256_algorithm: SHA-256 over the raw bytes of stage2_plan.md; verify with Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256
locked_before: Any Stage 2 interaction estimate had been computed or viewed. Annotation QC gates (G1-G5) and the pass/fail gate in section 5.3 are evaluated before any interaction model is fitted.

stage1_reference.note: Stage 1 pre-specification is unchanged by this plan and by the Stage 2 analysis.

stop2_decisions_recorded.power_figure: Reported as an approximate Monte-Carlo quantity with nsim disclosed; no Stage 1 number is re-locked.
stop2_decisions_recorded.b_plasma: Pooled into a single pre-declared primary type B_plasma.
stop2_decisions_recorded.stage2_gate: >=6 of 9 primary types evaluable, and CD8_T, NK and Microglia_P2RY12_TMEM119 each individually evaluable.
stop2_decisions_recorded.stage1_permutation_null: Not re-run; both inputs reproduce bit-exactly.

deviation_policy: Any change requires a dated addendum with its own SHA-256 written before the affected computation. Outcome-driven retuning after a Stage 2 estimate has been viewed is prohibited.
